# Jubilees Chapter 33 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 33:1 — "tower of the flock" vs. "Migdal-Eder"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "tower of the flock" | Literal translation of the place name |
| LOGOS | "Migdal-Eder" | Preserves the Hebrew/Ge'ez place name untranslated |
| PNEUMA | "tower of the flock" | Same as EMET |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "Migdal-Eder" — consistent with project convention of preserving place names. The Hebrew name is the recognizable form used in Genesis 35:21 and is immediately understood by scholars.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 33:4 — extent of Jacob's forgiveness

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "Jacob forgave him. But Jacob did not go in to Bilhah after this" | Literal, formal separation |
| LOGOS | "Jacob forgave him. But Jacob did not go in to Bilhah again after this" | Same with "again" for clarity |
| PNEUMA | "Jacob forgave him. But from that day on, Jacob never slept with Bilhah again" | Dynamic, explicit permanence |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "did not go in to Bilhah again after this." The "again" is warranted by the Ge'ez and clarifies that this is permanent. PNEUMA's "never slept with" is synonymous but less formal.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 33:8 — penalty for incest with daughter-in-law

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "they shall be burned with fire, both of them" | Literal, subject at end |
| LOGOS | "both of them shall be burned with fire" | Word order more natural |
| PNEUMA | "both are to be put to death by fire" | "Put to death by fire" is equivalent |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "both of them shall be burned with fire." The Ge'ez "fire" specification is precise — not just death but burning (cf. Lev 20:14). PNEUMA's "put to death by fire" is defensible but less vivid.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---
